state_fields.name: PLAYER_INTERACTION_TYPE1A_LATCH
state_fields.contract: set after an accepted type-0x1A contact and tested before the scene-specific type-0x62 response

state_fields.name: PLAYER_INTERACTION_TYPE1B_LATCH
state_fields.contract: type-0x1B player-collision latch retained for the downstream interaction response path

state_fields.name: PLAYER_INTERACTION_TYPE1C_LATCH
state_fields.contract: type-0x1C player-collision latch retained for the downstream interaction response path

state_fields.name: INTERACTION_TYPE12_PRESENTATION_LATCH
state_fields.contract: set after successful selector-0x4D Type-0x12 allocation and tested to choose the alternate presentation template

state_fields.name: ACTOR_TYPE18_19_CONTACT_COUNT
state_fields.contract: increments once per accepted contact and selects the terminal response at ten

state_fields.name: PLAYER_INTERACTION_TYPE4A_LATCH
state_fields.contract: type-0x4A collision latch selecting the B9 response branch

state_fields.name: PLAYER_INTERACTION_TYPE4C_LATCH
state_fields.contract: type-0x4C collision latch selecting the BA response branch

state_fields.name: MENU_PRESENTATION_TIMEOUT
state_fields.contract: initialized to 0x05DC and decremented by the menu presentation loop

state_fields.name: RAW_TERRAIN_QUERY_STATE
state_fields.contract: terrain-query response latch selecting the corresponding player animation and motion-reset branch

state_fields.name: SCENE_PRESENTATION_LATCH
state_fields.contract: selects the alternate scene-resource presentation path after a level-event player presentation command

state_fields.name: SCENE_RESOURCE_PRESENTATION_FILL_STATE
state_fields.contract: two-byte C000 presentation-fill cursor bounded by the 0x120-byte fill span

state_fields.name: LEVEL09_CALLBACK_PHASE
state_fields.contract: per-callback phase byte advanced modulo 0x80 alongside the independent type-0x50 spawn cooldown
